test_is_package_version_below: test if an installed package version is below a given threshold
test_is_package_version_at_least: test if an installed package version is at least a given threshold
patch_vllm_logging: patch vLLM logging level to ERROR by default to reduce noise
patch_vllm_disabled_tqdm: patch vLLM DisabledTqdm class to fix tqdm disabled state in vLLM versions below 0.11.1
patch_vllm_cached_tokenizer: patch vLLM get_cached_tokenizer for transformers v5 compatibility in vLLM versions below 0.12.0
